name: MDDL (Market Data Definition Language) 3.0-beta specification
description: The last full specification release of MDDL, an XML-based market data description language originally developed by the Financial Information Services Division (FISD) of the Software & Information Industry Association (SIIA). MDDL 3.0-beta (2007-03-01) is the final version FISD/SIIA published before winding the standard down; no later beta or final release was ever issued. The original mddl.org site is defunct, so these files were retrieved from the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine capture of mddl.org.
standards_body: Financial Information Services Division (FISD) of the Software & Information Industry Association (SIIA)
license_note: See mddl-license.pdf (downloaded alongside the spec) for MDDL's own licensing terms; not independently re-licensed by this repository.
